concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains several hyperlinks embedded within the agenda table (e.g., 'Minutes', 'Standard for Parcel Data Content', '(Summary)', and 'LGC Bylaws Revised'). In the output JSON, the text within the table cells is extracted as plain text, losing the inline hyperlinking context. Although the URLs appear as standalone artifacts at the end of the page, the links themselves are missing from their original context within the table cells.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Table containing clickable links for "Minutes" (item 3), "Standard for Parcel Data Content" and "Summary" (item 8), and "LGC Bylaws Revised" (item 8).
concerns.output_quote: Table cells contain plain text without links: "3. Approval of Minutes of May 11th Meeting", "o Vote: Standard for Parcel Data Content (Summary)", and "o Vote: LGC Bylaws Revised".

concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains a bulleted list with nested sub-items under '8. Committee Reports' (e.g., bullet 'Statewide Mapping Advisory Committee' with an indented sub-bullet 'Vote: Standard for Parcel Data Content (Summary)'). The output completely fails to use list structures for this content, instead extracting the bullets as raw plain text characters ('•', 'o') separated by line breaks inside table cells. This breaks accessibility, as screen readers will not recognize it as a list.
concerns.source_pdf_quote:
• Statewide Mapping Advisory Committee
  o Vote: Standard for Parcel Data Content (Summary)
concerns.output_quote: "• Statewide Mapping Advisory Committee\n  o Vote: Standard for Parcel Data Content (Summary)"

concerns.description: Displaced hyperlinks: 9 link(s) extracted as standalone elements instead of inline text
concerns.analysis: standalone_links=9, examples=['Minutes', 'Standard for Parcel Data Content', 'Summary']. Links should be inline within paragraphs, not separate blocks.
